summary: Join our specialized training course on report writing for monitoring and evaluation. Master the art of crafting clear, concise, and effective reports.
lede: Monitoring and evaluation report writing helps M&E officers, project managers and analysts turn project data into clear reports on performance and impact. The course covers results-based reporting, indicator and data-quality analysis, and synthesizing evidence into findings and actionable recommendations. It also develops skills in structuring evaluation reports around OECD-DAC criteria, presenting results with visualizations, and adapting summaries to stakeholder information needs.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for documenting project performance and communicating impact to diverse stakeholder groups.
modules: Digital Workflows and AI in M&E
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of project management cycles and be familiar with Microsoft Excel. Prior experience in data collection or field monitoring is recommended but not required. No programming knowledge is necessary.
